answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the timber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The dawn holds work receipts rather than names, so the lantern of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
